about: What each client's films used. tools/refbank.py pick/check read this to stop repeats; log appends to it.

straightscale.concept: Marketing cope-cope: the problem on charcoal (everyone says 'cilesi'), a gold-thread wipe to ivory/marble, then three steps; mismatched patches stitch into one set
straightscale.camera: locked frames, pull-back on the ad wall
straightscale.music: synth score 120 BPM, ducked under VO

straightscale.concept: Kliente qe kthehen: one gold client token rides the S of the logo at macro scale; the leak vs the return loop; pulls back into the real lockup
straightscale.camera: one continuous camera ride along the S path, ending in a pull-back

straightscale.concept: Qartesia: attention is expensive; a crimson focus bracket finds what matters in every beat on an ivory field; ends on the lockup
straightscale.camera: locked frame with focus pulls (blur as a spring) and subframe motion blur
straightscale.music: sampler score A minor to C major, ticking pulse, ducked under VO

straightscale.concept: The 22:47 race: she asks three businesses at once; the one whose phone answers first wins her
straightscale.camera: handheld night B-roll with push-ins, phone UI overlays, strategist to camera

straightscale.concept: One message, all the way: a crimson ball runs a marble wall of client steps; Reply is missing, it falls into the dark; rebuilt, it runs the full lit path and loops
straightscale.camera: follow-cam on the ball, dive into the hole, whip up, one pull-back to the whole map

straightscale.concept: Three things, one system: three labelled dots spin like a loader, merge into a crimson ball that lands as the real StraightScale mark
straightscale.camera: locked frame; the ball's squash, flight and landing carry the motion

straightscale.concept: The 108-hour week: a step chart climbs through the closed hours of one example week while a day-and-time counter ticks to 108
straightscale.camera: locked, no camera; chart folds onto its baseline

straightscale.concept: The step after the reply: replies walk a path REPLY-CALL-SIGNED and fall through a gap after the reply; three steps lay three planks; people cross; comment PATH
straightscale.camera: locked stage; one 1.06 push into the gap
straightscale.music: original score, sampled CC0 instruments (upright, pizz, strings, marimba, harp), 96 BPM, C to Am to C, ducked under VO
